sample_nearest_values: sample values from array_b at the nearest indices matching each value in value_a and return a stacked tensor
find_nearest_value: find the nearest value in a numpy array to a given scalar value using absolute difference
find_nearest_index: find the index of the nearest value in an array to a given scalar by setting return_index to True
review_sample_nearest: review the sample_nearest function that maps values from one array to another using nearest-neighbor lookup
refactor_find_nearest: refactor the find_nearest function to support vectorized input instead of scalar values
